allowed_origins.title: Allowed origins
allowed_origins.description: HTTP or HTTPS origins this browser may visit, such as https://example.com. Enter 1–32 normalized origins without paths, sorted in ascending order with no duplicates.

cdp_endpoint.title: Browser connection URL
cdp_endpoint.description: CDP endpoint of an existing browser. Only http:// or ws:// on localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1 is accepted, without credentials, query parameters or fragments.

max_snapshot_bytes.title: Snapshot text limit
max_snapshot_bytes.description: Maximum page text returned by a browser snapshot, measured in UTF-16 code units by the current browser driver, not encoded bytes.

screenshot_directory.title: Screenshot directory
screenshot_directory.description: Directory relative to the process workspace for saved screenshots. Absolute paths, . and .. path components are not allowed; the path must fit within 1,024 bytes.

timeout_ms.title: Operation timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Maximum duration of a browser operation, including its process execution.
